concerns.text: FR-007 requires the neural-teacher baseline to be trained 'on the original Causal Forcing++ dataset', but the plan (Scope Note, T2.1) substitutes the same synthetic physics dataset because no verified source for the original dataset exists. The plan correctly flags the gap, but the spec FR-007 remains unamended, so the plan element has no matching FR as written. The spec must be revised (e.g., FR-007 reworded to 'on a shared, verified dataset isolating the teacher-type comparison, with the original-dataset arm noted as unavailable') so the plan and spec agree; otherwise FR-007 is unbacked as literally stated.
